Current Spanish repeated probes: five controlled rejections, no completed partial text. Three Referent and two MarkerCorrespondence failures; no guessed restoration.

Current default English repeated probe: five complete outputs and nine exact order IDs, but Te enviaremos mixes address forms because formal policy is opt-in. Do not approve business use by these checks alone.
The short business-profile counterpart uses Le enviaremos. Spanish informaremos probe remains blocked.
URL probe preserves both URLs but Abierto is a poor rendering of imperative Open; integrity checks do not certify mood or intent.
Email probes can add al or use plural envien. Coreference, promises, agency, mood and full naturalness still require bilingual review.
